verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his charged Deathbringer Stance or get chained by W into a Q-E combo; you win if you punish his E (Umbral Dash) cooldown windows and deny his sustain.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane at 50.5% over 184 games — neither side has a lane or solo-kill edge. The matchup is decided by tempo: Aatrox wants to land Infernal Chains (W) and empower autos with Deathbringer Stance to heal through trades, while Camille wants to fight only when his Umbral Dash (E) is down and her Q (Precision Protocol) bonus damage is up.

theirWindow.what: His next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him off your max health — if his blade is glowing, back out of auto range and let him waste it on a minion wave instead.

yourWindow.when: his E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no other gap-closer or escape, so this is when to commit: pop Q (Precision Protocol) for the bonus damage and move speed, land W (Tactical Sweep) for the outer-cone slow and heal, and trade freely.

start.why: 49.1% win rate over 169 games at 78.2% pick — the extra sustain and damage let you match his Q trades and passive-fueled healing without losing the lane state.

boots.why: 51.4% win rate over 138 games at 75.4% pick — Aatrox does most of his damage through repeated basic attacks and Deathbringer Stance procs, so flat auto-attack reduction blunts both.

core.why: The on-hit damage and move speed amplify Q's bonus damage window and let you stick to or disengage from his Umbral Dash.
Adds sustain and AoE damage that scales your Tactical Sweep and Precision Protocol trades — 56.8% win rate over 37 games on this path.
Smooths the burst from his Q swings and the healing off his passive, converting damage taken into a delayed, mitigated hit.

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.7% win rate at 21.2% pick — rewards landing autos in the repeated melee trades this matchup forces and adds sustain against his passive and E healing.

summoners.why: 55.9% win rate over 16.4% pick — Ignite cuts into the healing his passive and E provide during close trades, while Teleport resets you onto the wave after backing for Trinity components.

playing.title: Track his Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Watch for the glow on his weapon — his next auto deals bonus magic damage and heals him off your max health. Disengage from auto range when it's up, punish when it's down.

playing.title: Trade only when his E is down
playing.detail: Umbral Dash (cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) is his only gap-closer and escape. Once he's used it, commit with Q for the bonus damage and move speed.

playing.title: Respect the W-E-Q chain
playing.detail: If Infernal Chains (W) lands on you, walk out of the impact zone immediately or you take the damage a second time — don't stand still and eat a follow-up Umbral Dash into Darkin Blade swings.

playing.title: Delay your Q recast
playing.detail: Precision Protocol does significantly more bonus damage if you wait before the recast rather than firing it back-to-back — hold it out when you're not under pressure.

playing.title: Pre-position near walls for E
playing.detail: Hookshot needs terrain to pull off of. Fight near lane walls so you can knock him up to engage or bail out of a bad chain per the standard matchup read.

playing.title: Save R for after his dash
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors him to the fight — use it once he's already spent Umbral Dash so he can't reposition, then follow with autos for the bonus magic damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the 50.5% win rate over 184 games are measured from live Camille vs Aatrox games on the current patch. The mechanical reasoning — passive timing, cooldown windows, and trade patterns — is our own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance to avoid Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo! If Camille is hit with (W), use Hookshot [E] to escape quickly. Purchase items that reduce healing to fight Aatrox!
